title: ST 五入口点击到内容可见（2秒目标）

panels.title: 点击到内容可见 P95（目标 ≤ 2000ms）
panels.description: 真实 Link 点击/导航开始到目标页面 usePageReady(content)。仅成功、前台 SPA 导航；必须与终态面板联合判断。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | context_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 2秒内可见占比
panels.description: 分子由同一条 page.navigation 的 duration_ms≤2000 计算，避免用占位或不同事件口径。

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | context_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | context_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | context_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 成功样本量（N<100 不判稳态）

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | context_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" [$__range]))

panels.title: 终态与卡住（防止成功样本幸存者偏差）
panels.description: ready/error/page_left 与 stalled 必须和 P95 同看；无数据不是达标。

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_route, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_terminal" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | event_data_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" [$__auto]))

sum by (event_data_route, event_data_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_stall" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_page_stall" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_route=~"^(/|/dramas|/characters|/creation|/profile)$" | event_data_tg_platform=~"^($tg_platform)$" [$__auto]))
